verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs show a consistent set of primitives (CLI, REST API, serverless functions, forms, blobs, DB, image CDN) usable from prototype to production without switching tools, and community praise (moving from Heroku/GitHub Pages) supports smooth early-to-mid growth. However, real-world reports of massive billing spikes and forced migrations at scale (DDoS charges, per-user billing changes) indicate the platform doesn't seamlessly absorb 'massive scale' without operational rearchitecting or platform flight.
